title: Trust levels and Start with Windows
notes: New Work freely in this project level: Claude edits that project's files and runs ordinary commands without asking, while deleting, publishing and chained commands still ask.

Permission cards: any command can be allowed once at any length, rule errors say what is wrong, and a new Allow bookkeeping files button (Settings, Permissions) lets log and memory updates run without asking.
Start with Windows: a Startup switch in Settings, Updates starts Studio when you sign in (off by default).
Reopened chats show Allowed lines instead of cancelled cards.

history.title: Website and updates
notes: This website, with the installer and release notes.
Studio checks for updates and installs them in one click, going back by itself if a new version doesn't start.
Studios from before v0.17: unzip this release and run Install Claude Studio.cmd to upgrade in place.
